name: Malcolm Kelner
bio: Malcolm Kelner is an American actor, writer, and comedian, is best known for his role as the bartender in Obsession (2025). Kelner was cast in the project after writing and acting with director Curry Barker on the comedy skit YouTube channel That's a Bad Idea. Kelner grew up in Hopkins, Minnesota.
